Howe open to Man Utd talks - Monday's gossip
1 of 6
- Published
Eddie Howe is open to holding talks with Manchester United if they part ways with manager Michael Carrick, three Premier League clubs are monitoring Bayern Munich's Lennart Karl, Manchester United are targeting a move for Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite.
Former Newcastle United boss Eddie Howe - who is out of work - would be interested in speaking to Manchester United if the Old Trafford club part ways with under-pressure manager Michael Carrick. (Sky Sports), external
Manchester United are targeting a move for 24-year-old Everton and England defender Jarrad Branthwaite as they aim to make big changes to their defence. (Football Insider), external
Former Watford, Burnley, Everton and Nottingham Forest boss Sean Dyche is the frontrunner for the Crystal Palace job if the Eagles sack manager Pierre Sage. (Telegraph - subscription required), external
Ex-Brentford boss Thomas Frank and former Wolves manager Vitor Pereira might also be in the running along with former Ferencvaros boss Robbie Keane. (Talksport), external
Tottenham's Sweden midfielder Lucas Bergvall, 20, is a target for Napoli and Barcelona. (Tuttomercato via Teamtalk), external
Manchester United will not terminate the registration of academy forward JJ Gabriel, 16, meaning he will not be able to leave the club until January, as Barcelona and Paris St-Germain seek to reach an agreement. (Football Insider), external
Arsenal, Liverpool and Manchester United are monitoring Bayern Munich's 18-year-old Germany midfielder Lennart Karl. (Teamtalk), external
Brazil defender Dodo is set to leave Fiorentina when his contract ends in the summer, with AC Milan, Juventus and Barcelona linked with the 27-year-old. (Football Italia), external
Brighton and RB Leipzig are among the clubs interested in Juventus' 19-year-old Germany Under-19s midfielder Adin Licina, who is on loan at Cremonese. (Gianluca di Marzo), external

המאמן הבריטי אדי האו הביע פתיחות לנהל שיחות עם הנהלת מנצ'סטר יונייטד במידה והמודון יחליט לסיים את דרכו של המאמן הנוכחי מייקל קאריק. במקביל, המועדון מסתמן כמכוון לחיזוק הגנתי ומתעניין בשירותיו של בלם אברטון ג'ארד בראנתווייט.

גזרת ההעברות באירופה רוגשת עם דיווחים נוספים על כך שמועדונים מובילים באנגליה עוקבים אחר קשר באיירן מינכן לנארט קרל. בנוסף, שחקנים צעירים נוספים דוגמת לוקאס ברגוואל מטוטנהאם וג'יי ג'יי גבריאל מבוקשים על ידי קבוצות פאר יבשתיות דוגמת ברצלונה ופריז סן ז'רמן.
